description: Defines structures for various upper PHY metrics related to LDPC, CRC, scrambling, modulation, PUSCH, PDSCH, and downlink processing within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: upper_phy_ldpc_metrics
classes.description: Aggregates LDPC decoder, encoder, rate matching, and rate dematching metrics.

classes.name: upper_phy_crc_metrics
classes.description: Holds metrics related to CRC calculation latencies and rates.

classes.name: upper_phy_scrambling_metrics
classes.description: Contains metrics for pseudo-random generator performance.

classes.name: upper_phy_mod_demod_evm_metrics
classes.description: Metrics for modulation mapping and EVM calculation.

classes.name: upper_phy_pusch_metrics
classes.description: Aggregates various PUSCH processing metrics, including channel estimation, equalization, demodulation, and processing latency.

classes.name: upper_phy_pdsch_metrics
classes.description: Contains metrics for PDSCH processing, including DM-RS, layer mapping, and processing latency.

classes.name: upper_phy_metrics
classes.description: Main structure aggregating all upper PHY metrics.
